meta.baseline: KR/TW live, after the Sep 23 patch
meta.notice: Global (NA/EU) early access opened Sep 30. If your client has fewer stigma slots or no level 25 yet, take each build's picks in the order shown: they're sorted most important first.
meta.note: Builds, tiers and priorities come from Korean Inven class boards (Jul 1 – Sep 29, 2026: guides, dummy tests and dungeon threads). Level-25 effects are KR/TW client tooltips; Lv 5–20 effects are from the Global client DB.

changelog.text: New Stigmas page: 6-slot builds with target levels for all 8 classes, level-up order with shard costs, unlock milestones, variants (Gladiator battle tank, Chanter battle healer, raid, solo, PvP), full 13-stigma tier lists, and the list from your image for comparison.

classes.imageNote: Same core as Korea. Korean players add Triniel's Dagger (their third level-25 pick) and Evasion Stance for stun mechanics.

builds.why: Illusive Clone and Swift Contract are your burst window (Heart Gore has no cooldown during Clone), so they get the first two level-25s. Triniel's Dagger is the third (+10% back damage at 25). Savage Fang is in the macro and adds +10% PvE damage at 15. Evasion Stance dodges stun mechanics. Throw Shadowblade is a ranged gap-closer and clears trash.

Assault Ambush gives +20% Attack for 5s on hit at level 5. Use it as the opener only when the boss dies in about 20s; otherwise its slow wind-up costs damage and Throw Shadowblade or Smoke Bomb is comfier.
src: Ambush vs Smoke Bomb vs Shadowblade

builds.why: Throw Shadowblade resets its cooldown on kills (Lv 10) and turns into an AoE (Lv 20), which makes pack farming fast. Keep Evasion Stance for elites.

Swift Contract's +10% Attack at 25, Smoke Bomb's Weakness at 25 and Evasion Stance's longer dodge are the picks Korean players keep. Their Aug 29 write-up says Assassin PvP stigmas are weak overall, so treat this as the least-bad set.

order.n: Illusive Clone 10 = +20% crit damage in your burst. Triniel's 10 = -10% to all your cooldowns on hit.
Savage Fang 15 adds +10% PvE damage for 10s. Evasion Stance 5 = a second dodge.
Clone 20: 50% chance of extra damage on crits. Swift 20: +10% more combat speed.
Savage Fang 20 always crits.
Advanced shards, one per level above 20.

milestones: x1.5 Exploit Weakness during the clone window
x1.5 Rear Smite, then x1.5 Assault Stance while it's up
Rear crits cut Illusive Clone's cooldown by 1s (Jul 8)

S: Your burst window: no Heart Gore cooldown, +20% extra damage

classes.imageNote: Close to the Korean list. Summon Resurrection is the one Korean clerics drop: they call it a learning-run crutch that costs a care slot. Salvation takes that slot.

builds.why: Light of Protection is a party-wide damage and damage-tolerance toggle. Earth Punishment and Prayer of Amplification are your party damage (tested level-25 damage order: Prayer > Earth Punishment > Light > Noble Aura). Benevolence is your group heal-over-time and cleanse. Salvation is your personal invulnerability; some dungeons (Deus, Noiran) need it.

builds.t: With a Chanter in the party
builds.why: Chanter's Undefeated Mantra and your Light of Protection don't stack (the higher level wins), so drop Light and move its level 25 to Noble Aura.
Salvation 25 gives the whole party its base effect for wipe mechanics. With a Chanter, swap Light of Protection for Yustiel's Power 25 (party damage tolerance). Absolution cleanses and heals.
The same six as the main build, levelled in the order below. Korean clerics tested Root and Voice of Doom as extra damage and found they barely help.

order.n: Prayer 5 = +20% PvE damage boost for the party. Earth Punishment 10 = +10% Double Chance (party +5%).
Cheap levels: each 1→5 costs 5 shards.
Earth Punishment 15 adds party Attack and Defense; 20 adds +10s duration.
Noble Aura 15: +30% damage to targets with Incapacitated Immunity (bosses).
Salvation 15 also covers your lowest-HP party member; 20 triggers it automatically when you're stunned or knocked down.
With a regular Chanter, put the third 25 into Noble Aura instead. Leftover 3 levels: Noble Aura 23.

milestones: +20% PvE damage boost: the biggest cheap party buff you have
Condemnation always crits on targets with Earth Punishment
Whole party gets Salvation's base effect

S: Party Double Chance and Attack; Condemnation crits
Highest damage per level-25 in tests
Party damage and tolerance (drop it if a Chanter is there)
A: 5-minute pet that hits bosses hard; 25 when Light is dropped
B: Raid tolerance when a Chanter covers Light
Cleanse and burst heal; less needed in Sanctuary 4
C: Only helps with Voice of Doom

classes.imageNote: Matches the Korean damage core. The two stigmas Korea adds are defensive: Arctic Armor (their third level-25) and Steel Barrier.

builds.why: Element Enhancement (+7% Double Chance at 25) and Fire Wall (+10% damage to targets with Embers at 25) are the two damage 25s. Arctic Armor is the third: players report its Mana Conversion is active about 70–75% of the time in PvE, so you can stand in damage instead of dodging. Delayed Explosion and Cold Storm are in your Hellfire key.
Only the stronger Cold Storm debuff counts when two Sorcerers use it, so one of you can drop it for Hibernation.

One player's day-1 clear setup: Arctic Armor, Steel Barrier and Hibernation for mechanics, with Element Enhancement, Fire Wall and Delayed Explosion for damage. Replies say Hibernation is optional once you know the fight.
Arctic Armor is the fixed 25. Soul Freeze at 25 ignores block and evasion. Glacial Smite is the best single-target hit for its cast time. Hibernation is an escape.

order.n: Delayed Explosion 10 = -10s cooldown. Fire Wall 5 = Embers deal extra damage on hit.
Element Enhancement 20: +10% more Fire and Water Attack. Fire Wall 20: +10s Embers.
Delayed Explosion 15 turns it into an AoE.
Arctic Armor 20: another +20% PvE damage tolerance.
Leftover 3 levels: Delayed Explosion or Steel Barrier 23.

milestones: x1.5 Robe of Flame, then x1.5 Grace of Enhancement while it's up
Ignores Block and Evasion and always crits

S: +Fire and Water Attack; x1.5 two passives
A: Tolerance and Mana Conversion; lets you trade hits
+15–25% damage taken from you; in the Hellfire key
B: Burst plus lifesteal, clunky in rotation

classes.imageNote: All four are in the Korean tank build. Korea adds Empyrean Lord's Punishment (a level-25 pick) and Noble Armor to fill six slots.

builds.why: Taunt's Shrink lowers the boss's damage tolerance for the whole party (5) and its crit-damage resist (25), so every DPS benefits. Battlefield Banner is your damage. Empyrean Lord's Punishment adds +10% PvE damage (15) and opens fights. Shield of Protection blocks stuns (2 uses, 3 at 25). Doom Shield engages and resets Annihilate. Noble Armor is always-on HP (2-min cooldown in KR/TW).
Nezekan's Shield puts a party-wide shield worth 41% of max HP up (+100% at 25) for unavoidable hits. Some tanks take Second Skin 25 instead for personal survival.
If your block stat already stops the hits, drop Shield of Protection for Assault Fury (+20% Attack for 5s on hit). The author calls it the highest-damage Templar setup.
Taunt does nothing solo, so Second Skin (damage tolerance) takes its slot. Doom Shield opens each pull and resets Annihilate.
src: Assembled from the stigma effects; not a single source

builds.why: Doom Shield 25 ignores block and evasion, so the knockdown lands. In party PvP, swap Battlefield Banner for Nezekan's Shield 25 (a 60k party shield) and make Comrade in Arms 25.

order.n: Taunt 5 = boss takes more damage from everyone. Doom Shield 5 = resets Annihilate. Shield of Protection 5 = a second block.
Banner 10: +10% weapon damage boost.
Taunt 15: -5s cooldown. Banner 20: -30s cooldown.
Empyrean Lord's Punishment 15: +10% PvE damage for 10s on hit.
Noble Armor 15: x1.5 Fury while it's up.
If you get stunned a lot, make Shield of Protection the third 25. Leftover 3 levels: Shield of Protection 23.

milestones: Shrink also cuts the boss's PvE damage tolerance by 10% for the party
Resets Annihilate on hit (Annihilate → Doom Shield → Annihilate)
Shrink also lowers the target's crit-damage resist by 5%

S: Party-wide boss debuff; the reason DPS want a Templar
C: Korean players call it a design miss

classes.imageNote: The exact core Korean Chanters use. The sixth slot is Healing Touch (party heal) or, in raids, Impeding Authority / Focused Defense.

builds.why: Undefeated Mantra (party damage and tolerance) and Power of the Storm (party combat speed and cooldowns) are why parties bring you: level them first and to 25. Sprint Mantra is the third 25. Marchutan's Wrath opens Dark Crush. Guardian Blessing must be at least 15 (x1.5 Wind's Promise). Healing Touch removes 5 debuffs at 15.

Keeps both party buffs and turns the rest into healing. Healing Touch 25 (-5s cooldown) is your burst heal and 5-debuff cleanse. Impeding Authority gives the party a 16%-HP shield, and 7% HP back when it breaks at 20. Sprint Mantra heals on hit. The guide author cleared Muspel boss 2 without a Cleric using these.

Tested on a clear: Storm 25 for the opening burst, Undefeated 25 over the Cleric's Light, and Guardian Blessing 25 for always-on damage tolerance. Impeding Authority pre-shields the jump-rope patterns. Focused Defense lets you block boss 1's block mechanic.

Since Sep 23, Undefeated Mantra and Power of the Storm do nothing while Battlefield Might is active (Abyss boss fights, Rifts, Time-Space battles). Free those slots: Marchutan's Wrath 20 adds heal reduction and a stun in PvP, and Focused Defense is your block.
The mantras are self-buffs too. Marchutan's Wrath keeps Dark Crush available. The guide author says solo Nightmare was much easier with Focused Defense.

order.n: The guide's exact order starts here. Storm 5 = -30s cooldown.
Undefeated 20: +5% Double Chance on top of the party buff.
Storm 20: +20% Attack for you, +10% for the party.
Guardian Blessing 15 = x1.5 Wind's Promise. Players call 15 the minimum.
Raid: make Guardian Blessing the third 25 instead of Sprint.

milestones: x1.5 Wind's Promise: the must-hit level

S: Party damage and tolerance; highest level in the party wins
Party speed and cooldowns; opening burst
A: Move speed and heal on hit
Opens Dark Crush; PvP heal cut

classes.imageNote: Same five Korean Gladiators start from. The sixth is Wave Armor or Armor of Balance, and Focused Block drops out when a Templar is tanking.

builds.why: Lunge Stance and Zikel's Blessing are fixed 25s for PvE and PvP. Wave Armor 25 hits twice and multiplies Murderous Burst and Experienced Counterstrike. Lifestealing Blade is about 6% of your damage (its 25 makes Predation always crit). Rage Burst is +10% PvE damage at 20. Armor of Balance is the high-end pick if you keep your front to the boss. Swap in Focused Block if you're getting hit in pugs.

When you hold the boss, Focused Block parries keep Experienced Counterstrike's frontal damage buff up (and restore HP at 20). Armor of Balance (+30% ailment resist at 25) and Wave Armor both multiply your passives, and Wave Armor reflects 10% damage. Players are main-tanking Trial stage 16 and Sanctuary 4 this way. For progression pulls, trade Rage Burst for Tenaciousness (3s invulnerability).
The Templar takes the block mechanics, so Focused Block goes and you run both armors plus Lifestealing Blade.
Lifestealing Blade and Wave Armor both heal you while hitting packs, and Focused Block covers elites. Rage Burst 5 cuts its cooldown from 45s to 30s.
src: Assembled from the stigma effects; not a single source

builds.why: Focused Block and Tenaciousness are your defense. Rage Burst 25 ignores block and evasion. Blade Toss cuts healing received by 50–70%, and players call it mandatory against healers. For group fights, swap one of them for Zikel's Blessing.

order.n: Rage Burst 5 = -15s cooldown. Zikel's 10 = +10% PvE damage.
Wave Armor 10 = x1.5 Experienced Counterstrike. Lifestealing 10 = party Predation.
Lunge 20: 50% chance to cut all cooldowns 1s on crit.
Wave Armor 15 = x1.5 Murderous Burst. Lifestealing 15 = -30s cooldown.
Rage Burst 20: +10% PvE damage boost.
Leftover 3 levels: Armor of Balance 23 (a longer window).

milestones: -15s cooldown (45s → 30s): the best 5 shards you can spend
+10% PvE damage boost while it's up
50% chance of extra damage on crit, about 5% of your total damage

S: Combat speed plus crit procs; fixed 25
A: About 6% of damage plus party Predation
+10% PvE damage at 20; in the macro
Highest ceiling if you stay frontal
B: Tanking and pugs; drop it behind a Templar

classes.imageNote: The same four Korean Spiritmasters call the only real PvE stigmas. The last two slots are Jointstrike: Destructive Attack (fixed Sep 10) and Siphon.

builds.why: Corrode is the first 25 (+25% damage taken from you at 25). Players who dropped it saw damage fall sharply. Ancient Spirit 25 casts after 3 basic attacks instead of 5. Flame Blessing 25 adds +100% to its procs on bosses (Incapacitated Immunity). Benediction is party damage and tolerance. Full-charge Destructive Attack about 3–4s after summoning Ancient Spirit.

Benediction 25 (+3s) and Flame Blessing 25 tested about even. With the 3 leftover levels, some players put Benediction at 25 and Flame Blessing at 23, since Flame Blessing's duration also grows per level.
Siphon heals, and from 15 it shields you for 30% of max HP (+30% at 25). Players who moved their third 25 from Flame Blessing to Siphon report much easier survival.

order.n: Corrode 5 = +15% spirit damage on the target. Ancient Spirit 10 = x1.5 Spirit's Descent.
Destructive Attack 5 turns into a charge skill (up to +200%).
Ancient Spirit 15 = skill after 5 basic attacks. Corrode 20 = +10s duration.
Benediction 20: +25% PvE damage and tolerance for you and the spirit.
Destructive Attack 20 resets Curse and Corrode cooldowns on its first hit. Siphon 15 adds a 30%-HP shield.
If you can only make one 25, make it Corrode.

milestones: +15% extra damage from spirits during Corrode
First hit resets Jointstrike: Curse and Corrode
Uses its skill after 3 basic attacks
+25% damage taken from the Spiritmaster during Corrode (Aug 26)

S: Target takes more damage from you and spirits
A: Extra damage procs; big vs bosses at 25
Damage plus tolerance for you and the spirit
B: Charge nuke; usable on cooldown since Sep 10
C: Spirit tanks for you; costs damage in PvE

classes.imageNote: Right on: these are the four Korean Rangers use. They add Explosive Arrow and Mother Nature's Breath (the 6th-slot pick, set it and forget it).

builds.why: Dummy test, 5 × 1 min each: Vaizel + Bow of Blessing + Supporting Fire at 25 was the strongest trio (102.2% vs 100% for Vaizel + Bow + Griffon). Supporting Fire also lifesteals and doesn't care about boss invulnerability phases. The 6th slot is Mother Nature's Breath: damage stigmas there added only about 0.4%.
Some players get higher numbers in real dungeons with Griffon at 25 (+20% damage to targets with Crimson Flames). On the dummy it tests about 2% lower. Pick one and check your Ctrl+X meter.
Burst them down fast; the longer the fight, the worse for you. Ensnaring Trap strips buffs, Ambush Kick 25 gives 2s stealth, and Mother Nature cleanses damage-over-time.

order.n: Supporting Fire 15 = -30s cooldown. Vaizel 10 = x1.5 Focused Eye.
Griffon 5 = castable while moving. Explosive 5 = -15s cooldown.
Supporting Fire 20 always crits.
Bow 15 = +20% crit damage. Griffon 20 = damage-over-time ticks twice as fast.
Tester's order: Vaizel, then Supporting Fire, then Bow. Leftover 3 levels: Griffon Arrow 23.

milestones: +10% weapon damage boost while it's up
10% chance of an extra shot with +30% PvE damage
